structure.unit: Franchises; Sale and Lease of Certain Municipal Public Property; Public Utilities
Provision of Cable Television Services by Certain Localities

text.section: Before a municipality may offer cable television service, the governing body of the municipality shall by a majority vote call an election on whether or not the municipality shall provide the proposed cable television services.

When under subsection A the governing body calls an election, the election shall be held:
At the next municipal general election or as provided in Article 5 (§ 24.2-681 et seq.) of Chapter 6 of Title 24.2 at a local special election the purpose of which is authorized by this section; and
In accordance with the law of Virginia regarding elections in Title 24.2 and as provided in this section.
The ballot at the election shall pose the question substantially as follows: "Shall this municipality provide cable television service to the inhabitants of the municipality?"
The ballot proposition shall not take effect until submitted to the electorate and approved by the majority of those voting on the ballot.
